title: Write a Makefile

checks.name: main.o and greet.o are built as separate object files
running make again has nothing to do
after changing greet.c, only greet.o is recompiled
checks.cmd: sleep 1; touch greet.c; out=$(make -n); echo "$out" | grep -q 'greet\.c' && ! echo "$out" | grep -q 'main\.c'

checks.name: make clean removes app and the object files
checks.cmd: make clean >/dev/null 2>&1 && test ! -e app && test ! -e main.o && test ! -e greet.o

hints: Command lines in a Makefile must begin with a Tab character, not spaces.
You need a rule for app that depends on main.o and greet.o, and one rule for each .o file.
Each .o rule lists the .c file and greet.h as dependencies, and compiles with -c.
